# Gannet Head Lighthouse

## Fog signal

The fog signal at Gannet Head sounds a blast of five seconds every 60 seconds when visibility falls below one mile. The engine is started by the keeper on watch and the compressors need eight minutes to reach pressure. The horn is tested for fifteen seconds every Saturday.

## Lens

The Gannet Head lens is turned by a weight-driven clock and one full turn takes 30 seconds. The keeper checks it with a stopwatch at dusk and writes the figure in the watch book.

## Landing

Stores land at the east slip when the swell is below two metres, judged from the height of water on the slip. The derrick is used for all heavy crates.
